ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous central regions on both lobes; black pigmentation zones are localized along the trailing edges and surrounding the median notch. A distinct isolated dark horizontal linear feature is present on the lower-left ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes, with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges transitioning into convex distal tips heavily obscured by textured clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups located at the distal tips of both lobes, characteristic of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent dark horizontal curvilinear mark on the lower portion of the left lobe; multiple thin vertical dark streaks on the upper interior margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal curvilinear dark scar on the lower-left lobe; significant white textured encrustations (parasitic/barnacle clusters) on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific curvilinear horizontal scar on the lower-left lobe provides a highly unique geometric identifier.
